# FlyThe BG

FlyThe BG is an independent web project providing free media tools focused on background removal, image compression, video compression, and clear privacy boundaries.

## Primary pages

- https://flythebg.com/ — FlyThe BG homepage and media toolkit
- https://flythebg.com/remove-bg — Background removal with protected AI processing
- https://flythebg.com/image-compressor — Browser-local image compression
- https://flythebg.com/video-compressor — Browser-local WebM video compression
- https://flythebg.com/features — Tool overview
- https://flythebg/faq — Frequently asked questions
- https://flythebg.com/privacy — Privacy policy
- https://flythebg.com/terms — Terms of use
- https://flythebg.com/blog — Media and privacy guides

## Entity

FlyThe BG is the site and project name. The project is maintained through the StackPilotMAX/flythebg GitHub repository.

## Processing boundaries

Image compression and video compression are designed to run locally in the browser. Background removal uses a protected server-side AI processing route when the user starts that tool. Refer to the Privacy Policy for the current processing and retention details.
